1.w: Hallelu YAH! Praise God in His sanctuary; praise Him in His mighty expanse!

2.w: Praise Him for His mighty acts; praise Him according to the abundance of His greatness!

3.w: Praise Him with the blast of the shofar; praise Him with the harp and lyre!

4.w: Praise Him with tambourine and dancing; praise Him with strings and flute!

5.w: Praise Him with cymbals sounding; praise Him with cymbals shouting!

6.w: Let everything that [has] breath praise YAH! Praise YAH!
